secure-computation-pq-signatures.name: secure-computation-pq-signatures
secure-computation-pq-signatures.description: Cryptographic Computing and Advanced Topics in Cybersecurity at Aarhus University: MPC protocols implemented in Go (oblivious transfer, fully homomorphic encryption, garbled circuits) for a private blood-type compatibility check, and an ongoing threshold-signatures and ML-DSA project.

car-sharing-app-security-analysis.name: car-sharing-app-security-analysis
car-sharing-app-security-analysis.description: Systems Security team project at Aarhus University: intercepted TLS on a rooted Android emulator with mitmproxy, decompiled and repackaged the APK, and hooked it at runtime with Frida. Found leaking and never-revoked session tokens, user enumeration, plaintext at-rest keys and trackers loaded before consent, each mapped to an adversary. The full report is available on request; feel free to reach out.
car-sharing-app-security-analysis.displayName: Security Analysis of a Car-Sharing Android App

imp-vsi-flow-security.name: imp-vsi-flow-security
imp-vsi-flow-security.description: Language-Based Security project at Aarhus University: noninterference and erasure enforced on a simple imperative language, statically with a security type system and dynamically with runtime monitors.

AUHack26.name: AUHack26
AUHack26.description: Hackathon project at AUHack 2026: a multiplayer strategy game where grid operators bid for energy contracts and speculate on the weather.

network-and-crypto-attacks.name: network-and-crypto-attacks
network-and-crypto-attacks.description: Systems Security assignments at Aarhus University: TCP injection and session hijacking with Scapy, RSA signature forgery and ElGamal malleability against web APIs, and Dirty COW privilege escalation.

verified-hoare-logic.name: verified-hoare-logic
verified-hoare-logic.description: Formal Software Verification project at Aarhus University: program equivalence (including non-determinism), constant-folding soundness and Hoare logic for the Imp language, with soundness and completeness proved in the Rocq proof assistant.
verified-hoare-logic.displayName: Verified Program Equivalence and Hoare Logic

Python-Quantum-Circuit-Simulator.name: Python-Quantum-Circuit-Simulator
Python-Quantum-Circuit-Simulator.description: A state-vector quantum circuit simulator in Python, with single-, two- and three-qubit gates, repeated measurements with statistics, and a small circuit file format.

starviewer-in-the-browser.name: starviewer-in-the-browser
starviewer-in-the-browser.description: Bachelor's thesis and research at the Graphics & Imaging Laboratory (University of Girona): a zero-footprint browser version of the Starviewer radiology (DICOM) viewer, compiling its C++/Qt/VTK codebase to WebAssembly; plus Starviewer's auto-update mechanism and an nnU-Net model segmenting vertebrae and intervertebral discs in MRI scans.

GEINF-4t-CSP-SAT.name: GEINF-4t-CSP-SAT
GEINF-4t-CSP-SAT.description: Declarative-programming project: a calendar scheduling problem modelled in MiniZinc and encoded to SAT in Scala with ScalAT.
GEINF-4t-CSP-SAT.displayName: Timetabling with SAT and Constraint Programming

GEINF-4t-ViquipediaSimil.name: GEINF-4t-ViquipediaSimil
GEINF-4t-ViquipediaSimil.description: A MapReduce pipeline in Scala computing document similarity over a Catalan Wikipedia dump.

GEINF-3r-Paradigmes.name: GEINF-3r-Paradigmes
GEINF-3r-Paradigmes.description: Programming-paradigms coursework: a propositional-logic project in Haskell and a nonogram solver in Prolog.

GEINF-3r-AI.name: GEINF-3r-AI
GEINF-3r-AI.description: Artificial-intelligence practicals in Python, including decision trees and an exploratory analysis of a video-game dataset.

GEINF-3r-MultiInterf-Hangman.name: GEINF-3r-MultiInterf-Hangman
GEINF-3r-MultiInterf-Hangman.description: A Hangman web game in plain JavaScript, built to match a reference design and be fully playable from the keyboard.

GEINF-3r-Xarxes.name: GEINF-3r-Xarxes
GEINF-3r-Xarxes.description: Computer-networks project: client and server for a simple HTTP-like web protocol over TCP sockets in C, with their own DNS-resolution and TCP layers.
GEINF-3r-Xarxes.displayName: Web Client and Server in C

GEINF-3r-EDS2-KairoMart.name: GEINF-3r-EDS2-KairoMart
GEINF-3r-EDS2-KairoMart.description: Software-design project: the architecture of a kart-racing game in Java, using the Strategy, Decorator and Singleton patterns.

Arduino-SIM900-automatic-calling.name: Arduino-SIM900-automatic-calling
Arduino-SIM900-automatic-calling.description: An Arduino with a SIM900 GSM module that calls three phone numbers when a normally closed switch opens.
